A branch is an independent new session. It does not rewrite, cancel, or resume any operation in the source session. You will see the copy scope and limitations before creating it.

An independent child session is created by copying the source session history through the selected persisted event, including that event. The copied history is not limited to the text shown above for sharing. The source session stays unchanged.

The new session is bound to the workspace configured for the source session. Both sessions share the same workspace files. No Git worktree or separate file copy is created, so later file operations may affect both sessions.
The new session uses the default model at the time of creation. It may not retain the source model, all settings, or all runtime state. This is not a full clone.
